learning_outcomes.text: Deepen the methods of scientific work in engineering sciences.
Become capable of methodical literature research.
Develop a clear structure as the basis for the Bachelor's thesis within short periods.
Conduct technical discussions on the thematic structure.

Dual students have additionally familiarized themselves with the requirements of the partner company regarding the preparation of a scientific paper. They have ensured that the topic and structure of their work are coordinated between their supervisor in the company and the supervising professor at the university.

syllabus_topics: Introduction / Information event via Moodle online course: Moodle/Faculty of Mechanical Engineering/Bachelor Thesis Seminar
Scientific requirements of the Bachelor's thesis ("Guideline for Bachelor's Thesis")
Introduction to research and documentation techniques (brief presentation of university library services)
Individual choice of topic and supervisor
Independent contact with companies and professors
Individual contact with the supervising lecturer and topic proposal
Familiarization and written formulation of the topic
Create and coordinate a timeline for the Bachelor's thesis
Establish the structure of the Bachelor's thesis
Prepare the registration for the Bachelor's thesis
assessment_rules: The Bachelor Thesis Seminar is graded as 'successful' by the supervising professor. The professor's signature on the Bachelor's thesis evaluation is required.
